label: Tool Storm
description: The five tools as window cards multiplying over the person: five that read as a hundred. mode 'fly': the windows arrive one by one from the sides and stack loosely (the first beat, readable). mode 'ring': they circle the frame, the same five coming round again, near cards big and bright, far ones small and dim (the second beat). mode 'storm': a blizzard of cards crossing the frame on their own lines with a spin, too fast to read, with white flashes (the third beat). Lightweight cards (the tool's colour, mark and the shape of its surface; no cursors, no figures). Sized to its box; every position is a function of the card's index so the frames are the same on every seek. Meant to ride over a live-action clip of the person.
